verified_facts.text: Sequoia Lodge sits atop Mount Lofty in the Adelaide Hills, affectionately known as Koala Mountain.
verified_facts.excerpt: sitting atop of Adelaide’s Mount Lofty, affectionately known as Koala Mountain

verified_facts.text: The lodge's 30-acre nature setting blends into the Adelaide Hills Botanic Gardens on one side of the peak and thousands of acres of national park on the other.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sequoia Lodge’s 30 acre nature setting blends into the Adelaide Hills Botanic Gardens on one side of the peak and thousands of acres of national park on the other

verified_facts.text: The lodge is about 20 minutes by car from the Adelaide CBD.
verified_facts.excerpt: approximately 20 minutes by car from Adelaide CBD

verified_facts.text: Artesian spring-fed hot pools overlook the Piccadilly Valley and are reserved exclusively for lodge guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sequoia Lodge features artesian spring-fed hot pools overlooking the Piccadilly Valley. Reserved exclusively for lodge guests

verified_facts.text: Within the lodge grounds there are artesian spring-fed hot pools and an infinity pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Within the lodge grounds, there are artesian spring-fed hot pools, and an infinity pool.

verified_facts.text: A 150-year-old Sequoia tree stands at the centre of the lodge.
verified_facts.excerpt: the massive 150-year-old Sequoia tree right in the lodge’s centre

verified_facts.text: Each open-plan suite is perched on the edge of the Piccadilly Valley with panoramic views from the sunken lounge, bedroom and bathroom.
verified_facts.excerpt: Your private open-plan suite is perched on the edge of the Piccadilly Valley, boasting panoramic views from the sunken lounge, bedroom and bathroom.

verified_facts.text: Suites have a sunken lounge with a stone-clad gas fireplace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sunken lounge room with stone-clad gas fireplace.

verified_facts.text: Each suite has an east-facing panoramic balcony with an expansive daybed.
verified_facts.excerpt: East-facing panoramic balcony with expansive daybed.

verified_facts.text: Guests can watch wallabies and kangaroos forage below the suite balconies.
verified_facts.excerpt: Watch the wallabies and kangaroos forage beneath your feet

verified_facts.text: Each suite features an original oil painting by resident artist Stephen Trebilcock, known for capturing local native florals.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each suite features an original oil painting by resident artist Stephen Trebilcock who is renowned for capturing unique local native florals

verified_facts.text: The Wellness Suite has a private screened wellness deck with a four-person cedar barrel sauna and a four-person cedar hot tub.
verified_facts.excerpt: A four-person traditional cedar barrel sauna, with a picture window framing the valley

verified_facts.text: Included on-site experiences change daily and seasonally and include dreamtime stories, sunrise yoga and guided nature walks of the Mount Lofty Botanic Garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: listen to ancient dreamtime stories, savour and learn from artisan winemakers, enjoy a sunrise yoga session or join a guided nature walk of the Mount Lofty Botanic Garden

verified_facts.text: Included experiences cover a guided nature hike along the Heysen Trail.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guided nature hike along the Heysen Trail

verified_facts.text: Daily breakfast, the minibar and nightly turndown service are included in the stay.
verified_facts.excerpt: Included in your stay are daily breakfast, the minibar, and nightly turndown service.

verified_facts.text: Sequoia dining is exclusive to lodge guests, with contemporary Australian menus served in the lodge lounge or in-suite.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests can enjoy a leisurely breakfast, light lunch and 2 or 3 course dinner in the lodge lounge or in the privacy of your own suite.

verified_facts.text: Guests can dine at the three-hatted Hardy's Verandah Restaurant on the neighbouring Mount Lofty Estate.
verified_facts.excerpt: a romantic dinner at the neighbouring Hardy’s Verandah is essential: the three-hatted restaurant offers a degustation experience

verified_facts.text: Gatekeeper's Day Spa sits in a cottage just outside the estate's historical entrance gate.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Gatekeeper’s Day Spa cottage sits just outside of the historical entrance gate.

verified_facts.text: Mount Lofty Estate is home to South Australia's two highest altitude vineyards.
verified_facts.excerpt: Mount Lofty Estate is also home to South Australia’s two highest altitude vineyards

verified_facts.text: Guests have exclusive use of the lodge lounge, with multiple fireplaces, sunken lounges, 180-degree valley views and a panoramic sun deck.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sequoia guests have exclusive use of the lodge’s lounge which features multiple fireplaces, comfortable sunken lounges, 180° views across the valley, and a panoramic sun deck.

verified_facts.text: The entire lodge can be booked for a completely private experience.
verified_facts.excerpt: it is possible to book out the entire lodge to create a completely private experience

verified_facts.text: Sequoia is a member of Relais & Chateaux.
verified_facts.excerpt: A proud member of Relais & Châteaux

verified_facts.text: Off-site experiences are available as private charters exclusive to guests, such as going behind the scenes at RM Williams or a private helicopter to meet the winemaker.
verified_facts.excerpt: Go behind the scenes at RM Williams, drive a Ferrari through the Adelaide Hills, or take a private helicopter to meet the winemaker.

verified_facts.text: Off-site experiences carry additional charges and are subject to seasonal change.
verified_facts.excerpt: Off-site experiences additional charges apply and subject to seasonal change

verified_facts.text: Premium dining, Gatekeeper's Day Spa and curated picnics attract additional charges.
verified_facts.excerpt: Premium dining, Gatekeeper’s Day Spa and curated picnics attract additional charges.

verified_facts.text: Suites were brought to life by local suppliers, craftsmen and artisans, with warm accents of wood and stone.
verified_facts.excerpt: The suites have been brought to life by local suppliers, craftsmen and artisans, creating a tranquil oasis with a calming colour palette punctuated by warm accents of wood and stone.
